item.title: Review: Australia is the only home I remember. But every time immigration makes headlines, my skin colour makes me a target | Zoya Patel
item.description: For generations, multitudes have contributed to this country. We need our leaders to call out racism and speak up for multiculturalism At a family dinner the other night, my nine-year-old niece asked: “What is an immigrant?” For a moment, all of the adults were floored. Sitting around the table were my parents, sisters and brother-in-law, all of us immigrants who came to Australia from Fiji. My niece and her siblings were born in Australia. Remarkably, she transcribed all but one segment by ear, a feat in itself. That she manages to tell the story chronologically over a 38-minute, three-movement span is equally impressive.
